notes: Added API, revocation, testing, and integration coverage for token lifecycle.

GPTR-F-002-S84.title: Token Revocation Logic
GPTR-F-002-S84.description: Implement revocation capability allowing tokens to be explicitly invalidated via revoked_at timestamp. Ensure revoked tokens are rejected during authentication and cannot be reactivated.
GPTR-F-002-S84.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No revocation logic currently implemented

GPTR-F-002-S85.title: Token Management API Endpoints
GPTR-F-002-S85.description: Expose internal API endpoints for token lifecycle operations including create, rotate, revoke, and validate. Ensure endpoints are restricted to authorized system actors and aligned with existing Azure Function patterns.
GPTR-F-002-S85.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/function_app.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No lifecycle management endpoints exist

GPTR-F-002-S86.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
GPTR-F-002-S86.description: Create comprehensive tests covering token creation, expiration, rotation chains, and revocation. Validate rejection paths and edge cases including expired-then-rotated and revoked tokens.
GPTR-F-002-S86.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader.py; Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader_integration.py; GAP: No lifecycle test coverage exists

GPTR-F-002-S87.title: GPTReader Integration with Lifecycle Enforcement
GPTR-F-002-S87.description: Integrate lifecycle validation (expiration, rotation, revocation) into GPTReader request handling path to ensure all data access enforces latest valid token state.
